summary: Conditional dispatch helper: reads a flag at this+0x10 and the object pointer at this+0x0, then forwards the second argument a2 (with a constant third argument of 1) to either AudioStreamBufferRead or sub_587F64 depending on the flag. Returns the chosen callee's result.

operations.description: Load the flag field this+0x10 into a local; it selects the call path.
Load the object pointer at this+0x0; it is passed as the first argument to both callees.
If the flag at this+0x10 is non-zero, take the AudioStreamBufferRead path; otherwise take the sub_587F64 path.
Call AudioStreamBufferRead(obj, a2, 1) when the flag is set.
Call sub_587F64(obj, a2, 1) when the flag is clear.
Return the return value of whichever callee was dispatched to.
